name: Parameters.v_alpha_mul_relDifferentGen
summary: Case analysis on whether c₀ and 1 − c₀ = c̄₀ lie in w.

steps.claim: Unfold the components: α_w = 1/relDifferentGen(P, s) if c₀ ∈ w and 1 otherwise; conj(α)_w = 1/conj(relDifferentGen(P, s)) if c₀ ∈ conj(w), i.e. if conj(c₀) = 1 − c₀ ∈ w, and 1 otherwise.

Cases: c₀ and 1 − c₀ both in w is impossible (1 ∉ w); in the mixed cases the product is relDifferentGen(P, s)/relDifferentGen(P, s) or relDifferentGen(P, s)/conj(relDifferentGen(P, s)), of valuation 1 because conj(relDifferentGen(P, s)) has the valuation of relDifferentGen(P, s) (`valuation_map_relDifferentGen` for f = conj, `valuation_star`); otherwise the product is relDifferentGen(P, s) and w ∤ relDifferentGen(P, s): else w ∣ N₁(P, s) (`relDifferentGen_dvd_N₁`), and N₁(P, s) divides a power of (d(P) + 1)/4 = c₀(1 − c₀) (every prime factor of N₁(P, s) divides (d(P) + 1)/4, `dvd_norm_c₀`), so c₀ ∈ w or 1 − c₀ ∈ w.
steps.lean:
split_ifs <;> simp_all [w.1.sub_mem_iff_left, valuation_map_relDifferentGen _ star_injective _ ▸
    valuation_star w _, one_notMem, mt (w.2.2 ∘ (c₀InE_mul_one_sub ..).substr ∘ w.2.mem_of_pow_mem
    (P.N₁ s) ∘ mem_of_dvd _ (.trans relDifferentGen_dvd_N₁
    (mod_cast .natCast (by grind [(N₁ ..).dvd_pow_self_iff out, dvd_norm_c₀, lt_d]))))]
